citations.case: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, Excludes1 notes at H11.15 (pingueculitis is coded to H10.81-) and at H10.81 (pinguecula is coded to H11.15-), with ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.12.a (an Excludes1 note means the excluded code is never used at the same time as the code above the note); Section I.B.13 (laterality: the code names whether the condition is on the left, the right or bilateral); Section I.B.5 (signs and symptoms associated routinely with a disease process are not assigned as additional codes)

coder_notes: The provider lists pingueculitis and pinguecula of the right eye and states the pinguecula is inflamed. An inflamed pinguecula is coded as pingueculitis. The pinguecula code (H11.151) is not reported with it: the two categories carry Excludes1 notes for each other. The left eye is normal. Redness and irritation are symptoms of the condition. Traps: reporting the pinguecula code with the pingueculitis code; the pinguecula code alone; a left-eye, bilateral or unspecified-eye code; an unspecified conjunctivitis code
